name: qwen3.8-27b-fp8
summary: Aug 2026 dense 27B hybrid: 16 gated attention + 48 Gated DeltaNet layers, official FP8; the newest Qwen that fits one 80 GB card

hf.quant: FP8 E4M3, 128×128 blocks (official); the weights include a vision encoder and an MTP head

evidence: Not served. Publisher reports Terminal-Bench 2.1 73.0 and SWE-Pro 61.7 (model card, 2026-10-03); shortlist signals only.
caveats: vLLM issue #55766 (open on 2026-10-03): hybrid GDN models can emit NaN logits after a prefix-cache hit; the symptom is runs of '!' tokens
Prefix caching for the recurrent layers uses vLLM's 'align' checkpoints (the default with prefix caching), so hits land on block boundaries
On the A100 FP8 runs weight-only through Marlin; native FP8 compute needs H100 or GH200
Sampling is the card's non-thinking set; thinking is off through chat_template_kwargs
